items.author: Aaron Levie
items.bio: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
items.summary_en:
Agents spawning other agents, agents operating in the background on every task, and agent swarms will consume 1,000X more tokens than people prompting agents 1 at a time. 

The usage of AI as a chat system that can only work for you at the pace that you can prompt it will seem like a relic within a year or two. The vast, vast majority of tokens will be consumed by agents that are just doing continuous work for us in the background and in our workflows.

This is why we’re still so early in the curve of AI agent adoption right now, and how much more compute and infrastructure build out will be needed to sustain this.
items.summary_zh: 单个聊天式调用很快会变成古董，真正吃掉海量 token 的会是后台持续工作的 agent、互相调度的 agent 和 agent swarm。现在的 AI agent 采用还只是曲线最早期，后面需要的算力和基础设施扩张会大得多。

items.author: Guillermo Rauch
items.bio: @vercel CEO
items.summary_en:
Some interesting machine & agent Vercel traffic stats.

• Across the entire Vercel network, 58.18% traffic is bot-originated (last 30d). This was 32% in Jan 2024.

• 60%+ of deployments on Vercel are now agentic, up from ~3% in Jan 2026.

• Up to 83% of pageviews are now coming from agents to Vercel's own documentation sites. The % reliably increases the more we optimize content for them.

I expect 'direct' human internet traffic to basically become a rounding error in coming years. The web will thrive, but it will be built for and by agents.
items.summary_zh: Vercel 的流量已经被机器接管：全网 58.18% 来自 bot，部署里 60%+ 是 agent 做的，文档站最高 83% pageview 来自 agent。人类“直接访问”很快会变成误差项，Web 还会繁荣，但会主要为 agent、由 agent 建造。

items.author: Madhu Guru
items.bio: Sr Director, AI at Meta; Prev: Google - Led Gemini, Veo, Nano Banana.
items.summary_en:
Open-weight models did not start the drop in price per unit of intelligence. They are a tailwind on a trend that was already underway.

For the last few years, a few factors have driven price drops:

1/ Model builders distilling their best models into smaller ones, with cheaper inference

2/ Infra efficiency

3/ Competition between model providers

You can see this pattern with every model company: Version x of the mid-size model = intelligence of version x-1 of the large model.  Same intelligence for less $.
items.summary_zh: 开源权重模型不是“智能单价”下跌的起点，只是给早已发生的趋势又加了一把风。真正压价的是大模型厂商把顶级模型蒸馏成更小更便宜的版本、推理基础设施变高效，以及供应商之间互相卷到同等智能越来越不值钱。

items.author: No Priors
items.title: Beam: The Great American Open Model with ReflectionAI Co-Founder and CEO Misha Laskin
items.summary_en:
Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:26
When you remove cyber offensive capabilities, you also remove cyber defensive capabilities. The state of the world today is that we have a few 100 safety researchers within closed labs that understand how these things work. And despite their best intentions, is impossible to cover the long tail of unintended consequences that these systems might have. A very powerful closed model went and hacked into another company, and the only way that company could remediate itself was by using open models to protect itself. That's the empirical evidence of the world that we're in.

Speaker 1 | 00:26 - 00:34
Linus' law, with enough eyeballs, all bugs become shallow. I have the belief that with enough eyeballs, most security and safety vulnerabilities become shallow as well.

Speaker 2 | 00:41 - 00:57
Today, we're joined by Misha Laskom, the co founder and CEO of Reflection AI. Reflection provides open weight models to power the future of intelligence. Misha Pryor was a researcher at Google DeepMind and received his PhD in Physics. Welcome, Inno Pryor's. Great to have you here today.

Speaker 1 | 00:57 - 00:59
Yeah, it's great to be here. Thanks for having me.

Speaker 2 | 00:59 - 01:11
Could you give us an update on where things are at? Mean, obviously, you guys have been pioneering really interesting work in open weights and open source models, particularly with a US bent. Can you talk a bit what you've been up to and what you guys have been building?

Speaker 1 | 01:11 - 01:38
Yeah, so for the last twelve months, we set, right, the mission of the company to build frontier open intelligence and make it widely accessible. And effectively, it's been a sprint to set up a lab that is capable of of doing such things. It it kind of feels like maybe there's a Rei
items.summary_zh: 去掉网络攻击能力，也会一起废掉网络防御能力；把安全押在少数闭源实验室研究员身上，根本覆盖不了这些系统的长尾风险。现实已经证明：强大的闭源模型能黑进别人公司，而受害者最后只能靠开放模型自救。
